description:
There was a time when I received a lot of attention and love. The leader of a world-famous idol group, Cheon Sa-Yoon. However, due to an uncontrollable scandal and rumors that suddenly broke out, I fell. Misfortune piled up and grew like a snowball, but all Sa-Yoon could do was work hard and run. Then Sa-Yoon received a sponsorship offer. Sa-Yoon refused, but because of the debt that had to be paid by tomorrow, he had no choice but to accept the sponsorship that he had refused until now. And then he met… 

 *“Why are you acting so sullen and acting like this? Is this how you seduce sponsors?”
“Then admit it. Because I really like you.”*

Laxer, the Korean branch manager of Belkacia. 

*“It’s natural for a Westerner to protect his wife.”*

He was a person who cared for Sa-Yoon to an unusual degree.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
